name: Update Manager Advanced
description: The module modifies the Drupal "Updates available" email to include the information normally shown at /admin/reports/updates/update, with links to the module updates and their release notes.
project_description:
Advanced Update Report enhances the default Drupal “Available updates” email by including detailed information normally available at /admin/reports/updates/update , along with direct links to module updates and their release notes.

 This allows you to quickly assess the importance of updates without logging into the site. For example, if only a non-critical module is affected, you can safely postpone the update and save time.

 Features 
 
 Extends the default update notification email with detailed update information 
 Includes direct links to project pages and release notes 
 Helps prioritize updates without opening the Drupal admin interface 
 Provides a "Security Updates" block for admin visibility 
 
 Security Updates Block 
 The module provides a "Security Updates" block that can be placed in a prominent region (e.g., alert or header) to keep administrators informed about critical updates.

 Dependencies 
 No additional dependencies are required.

 Optionally, you can use a mail theming module such as Swift Mailer (or any alternative) to send emails styled with your site’s theme.

 Roadmap 
 Additional useful features are planned for future releases.
